provenance.paper_title: GUI Odyssey: A Comprehensive Dataset for Cross-App GUI Navigation on Mobile Devices

representation_paths.memory_component: history screenshot memory: tokens of the previous delta=4 screenshots, compressed by a learned history resampler and concatenated with the current screen tokens, instruction and previous actions

evidence.figure_or_table: Architecture figure of OdysseyAgent; Table 4 (ablation on historical information)
evidence.paraphrase: OdysseyAgent stores the previous screenshots of the episode and compresses their visual tokens with a single-layer cross-attention 'history resampler' whose learnable embeddings act as queries and whose keys/values are the historical screenshot tokens; the resulting 256 compressed history tokens (vs 1,024 for naive multi-image input) are concatenated with the current screenshot tokens, the instruction and the previous actions before the LLM decodes the next action. Default history length is delta=4. The raw historical screenshots exist in the trajectory and are re-encoded, so the perceptual source is recoverable but is not itself stored as memory content.

representation_paths.memory_component: previous-action history string carried alongside the compressed screenshot history

evidence.figure_or_table: Table 4 (previous actions and historical screenshots ablated separately)
evidence.paraphrase: The agent input explicitly includes the previous actions of the episode together with the compressed historical screenshot tokens; the ablation removes previous actions and historical screenshots as distinct history sources, showing both contribute to cross-app navigation accuracy.

derived.hybrid_relation: Compressed historical screenshot tokens and the textual previous-action record are jointly concatenated into the agent input for next-action prediction.

adjudication_notes: Full-text HTML (arXiv v2) consulted. Included because the history resampler is a named architectural contribution for retaining and reusing past screenshots across steps of a long cross-app episode, and is ablated (Table 4); it is not merely an incidental context window. This inclusion is nevertheless borderline: the memory is a fixed-length sliding history rather than an accumulating store.

T1 by the strict rule: the history is a fixed window re-encoded by a frozen-policy cross-attention module at every step. There is no persistent memory artifact that is written, revised, reorganized or forgotten at inference time, and no recurrent state carried forward beyond re-reading the last delta screenshots. Training of the resampler happens offline during supervised fine-tuning and does not raise the tier.
The GUI Odyssey dataset itself was not given a benchmark record: it evaluates cross-app navigation generalization (random/task/device/app splits) rather than memory capability.
